about_the_game:
KEBABSTAR PROLOGUE: MORE THAN A GAME

While average gamers waste their time on rigid, static scripts, you will encounter a living, breathing system in Kebabstar that thinks for itself and dares to challenge your intellect.

ONLY SLAVES FEED FROM THE MASTER'S HAND.

Some evil corporations are feeding you sugar-coated chains.

BITING IS NOT ENOUGH.

ANNIHILATE THE CULT IN CYPRUS!

Witness the extraordinary and epic journey of a humble kebab seller who becomes an Agent after losing everything in the desert. Your mission? To destroy this sinister cult and the tech company behind it deep within the Cyprus.

From flipping kebabs on the streets to partying in luxury parties, you’ll rise through the ranks and transform into an elite agent. In this epic and hilarious simulation, cook kebabs, charm the ladies, and shoot the fire!

Kebabstar "Prologue" contains:

  • Innovative physics based cooking gameplay available.

  • Total 3 of chapters available in total of 12 chapters.

  • Arabia, Dubai and Grand Bazaar worlds available to play.

Kebabstar "Prologue" does not contains:

  • Shooting gameplay mechanics is not available on Kebabstar Prologue.

  • Cyprus Island is not available on Kebabstar Prologue.

  • Some of characters are not available on Kebabstar Prologue.

  • The Ice Cream cult content is not available on Kebabstar Prologue.

KEBABSTAR: MORE THAN A GAME

"ONLY SLAVES EAT FROM THE MASTER'S HAND."
The US, UK, and Israel companies are feeding you chains wrapped in sugar.

BITING IS NOT ENOUGH. DEVOUR THE CULT.

Witness the authentic and epic journey of a humble kebab seller who becomes an AI agent after losing everything in the desert. Your mission? To seek and destroy this sinister cult and the tech company behind it.
- Player remains as a kebab seller throughout in our "Kebabstar Prologue" game.

From flipping kebabs on the streets to partying in luxury parties, you’ll rise through the ranks and transform into an elite AI Agent. In this epic and hilarious simulation, cook kebabs, charm the ladies and shoot the fire!

- No combat is present in the our "Kebabstar Prologue" game.  

Note: Shooting gameplay system is only available on our main game.

FEEL YOUR REAL HANDS AND COOKING LIKE NEVER BEFORE

You're not just an agent — you're stepping into the full cooking experience, one step at a time. Feel the grip of the knife, hold the pan, mix the ingredients, and become a true chef as you master the art of kebab-making. Unlike any other game, Kebabstar Prologue uses advanced inverse kinematics to deliver a hyper-realistic cooking experience where your hero’s hands move just like your own.

ROLEPLAY AS CHEF

You're not just an ordinary kebab master, you’re the hero of a wild tale rising to superstardom. With hilarious, funny, and unforgettable characters, we’re not exaggerating  you’ll feel them living inside you!

EXTRAORDINARY STORYLINE 

As you master the art of kebab-making, outsmart your rivals for your own gain, and become a social media sensation, you discover that your beloved camel was kidnapped by a dark cult named Ice Cream Cult and prisoned at the island.

AN ACTION-SIM FILLED WITH ADVENTURE, LOVE & COMEDY

After losing everything, you put on a mysterious pair of glasses and suddenly find yourself at a luxury party — with nothing left to your name. From the deserts to Cyprus, you’ll meet a blind man and begin an epic, super journey into the world of artificial intelligence espionage.

EXCLUSIVE GRAPHICS

Get ready to be blown away by the stunning visuals of Kebabstar Prologue. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the game delivers an unmatched level of realism and immersion that transports you to a world like no other.

A WORLD THAT FEELS ALIVE

Every scene in Kebabstar Prologue is crafted with incredible attention to detail — from the bustling vendors of the Grand Bazaar to the sizzling grills of kebab stands. As you explore the vibrant world of Kebabstar Prologue, you’ll encounter characters and environments that feel so real, it’s like stepping into another life.

IMMERSIVE ENVIRONMENTS

Experience the thrill of stepping into a world where every kebab stand, lively setting, and eccentric character feels truly lifelike. This isn’t just one location — you’ll journey through Arabia, Dubai, and Istanbul, each with its own flavor of realism and storylines action.

Note: The Cyprus Island is available in our main game.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains limited nudity, alcohol and erotic dances. Some players may find these elements culturally sensitive or inappropriate.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.3 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: World's first AI agentic game. Play as the first AI AGENT and also AGENT HERO. Go and confront Ice Agents in Cyprus. Infinite worlds and infinite stories await, but you have one target: The power that made you. Break the simulation before it breaks you.
